channel.title: Coastal Eventures: upcoming events
channel.description: The next 40 dated events on the Gulf Coast.

item.title: 2026 Walk to End Alzheimer's: Emerald Coast (SAT 11/7)
item.description: Saturday 11/7 · registration 9:30 AM · ceremony 10:30 AM · walk follows | Grand Boulevard | Free. The Alzheimer's Association holds its Walk to End Alzheimer's for the Emerald Coast on Saturday, November 7 at Grand Boulevard in Miramar Beach. Registration is at 9:30 AM, the ceremony is at 10:30 AM and the walk starts right after. There is no registration fee, but the association asks each walker to donate and raise funds, and walkers who raise at least $100 get an event T-shirt by mail.

item.title: A Fight at the Opera by USA Opera Theatre (SAT 11/7)
item.description: Friday 11/6 · 7:30 PM · Sunday 11/8 · 3:00 PM | Laidlaw Performing Arts Center Recital Hall, University of South Alabama | from $5. USA Opera Theatre presents A Fight at the Opera on Friday November 6 at 7:30 PM and again on Sunday November 8 at 3:00 PM. Both performances are in the Laidlaw Performing Arts Center recital hall as part of the Musical Arts Concert Series. Tickets are sold at the door.

item.title: A Gentleman's Guide to Love and Murder at UWF (SAT 11/7)
item.description: Fri 11/6, Sat 11/7, Fri 11/13, Sat 11/14 at 7:30 PM · Sun 11/8 and Sun 11/15 at 2:30 PM | Besser Studio Theatre, UWF Center for Fine and Performing Arts | No published price. UWF Theatre stages the Tony-winning musical comedy about a poor young man who plots his way past the relatives ahead of him in line for an earldom. There are four evening shows at 7:30 PM and two Sunday matinees at 2:30 PM. UWF says adult situations and subject matter may make the show inappropriate for some audiences.

item.title: Adventure Zone at Steve's Fishing and Adventure Farm (SAT 11/7)
item.description: Mon-Sat through Nov 24 · mostly 2 PM to 6 PM, 2 PM to 5 PM from Nov 16 | Steve's Fishing and Adventure Farm | from $19.45. Steve's Farm has rebranded as Steve's Fishing and Adventure Farm and opened a fall attraction in Walnut Hill with a corn maze, a giant slide, a kids' zipline, a jump pad, hayrides, a wagon train, a sunflower field and a pumpkin patch. It suits a family with small children who want a half day outdoors. The farm's ticket page lists day passes at $15.00 to $19.45 and a $35 season pass, so check it for each day's hours before driving out.

item.title: Blue Angels Homecoming Air Show: NAS Pensacola (SAT 11/7)
item.description: Fri 11/6 and Sat 11/7 · gates 8 AM, show 9:30 AM | NAS Pensacola | Free. The season-closing Homecoming show on the base is the fall core-memory for an aviation kid.

item.title: Cat Video Fest 2026 at Suds N Cinema (SAT 11/7)
item.description: Saturday 11/7 · 5:15 PM show · doors 4:30 PM | Suds N Cinema | from $7. Cat Video Fest strings together a 77 minute reel of the latest and funniest cat clips on the big screen at Suds N Cinema. The festival bills itself as the world's number one cat video festival. Guests are welcome to wear cat themed clothing or get cat face paint.

item.title: Christmas on the Bayou Shopping Spectacular (SAT 11/7)
item.description: Fri 11/6 · 5:00 PM to 9:00 PM · Sat 11/7 · 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM | Bayou La Batre Community Center | from $5. The eighth annual Christmas on the Bayou Shopping Spectacular fills the Bayou La Batre Community Center with local vendors, food trucks, a silent auction and pictures with Santa Claus. Every dollar from tickets, door sales and the silent auction goes to the Bayou La Batre Senior Center.

item.title: Disney's High School Musical JR at the Daphne Civic Center (SAT 11/7)
item.description: Friday 11/6 to Sunday 11/8 · Showtimes on the ticket page | Daphne Civic Center | No published price. Eastern Shore Repertory Theatre stages Disney's High School Musical JR with young performers from across the Eastern Shore. The Daphne Civic Center is set up as East High, with a gymnasium atmosphere and game-day energy. It is a family show for anyone who grew up with the Wildcats.

item.title: Elevate Relationship Workshop at the Fort Walton Beach Library (SAT 11/7)
item.description: Friday 10/30 · 6:00 PM · Saturday 10/31 · 9:00 AM · Saturday 11/7 · 9:00 AM | Fort Walton Beach Library | No published price. Healthy Relationships Emerald Coast returns to the Fort Walton Beach Library with a three-day Elevate Relationship Workshop for adults. Sessions run Friday October 30 from 6:00 PM to 8:00 PM, Saturday October 31 from 9:00 AM to 12:00 PM and Saturday November 7 from 9:00 AM to 1:30 PM. Lunch is provided on November 7.

item.title: Emerald Coast Out of the Darkness Walk (SAT 11/7)
item.description: Saturday 11/7 · check-in 9:00 AM, walk 10:00 AM | Beasley Park | Free. The American Foundation for Suicide Prevention walks at Beasley Park to raise awareness, support one another and remember loved ones. Check-in is at 9 AM and the walk starts at 10 AM. Registration is free online.

item.title: Emerald Coast Rodeo (SAT 11/7)
item.description: Fri 11/6 and Sat 11/7 · gates 5:30 PM, mutton bustin 6:30 PM, rodeo 7:30 PM | Northwest Florida State College | from $20. Northwest Florida State College hosts the fourth annual Emerald Coast Rodeo on Friday and Saturday night. Gates open at 5:30 PM, the kids' mutton bustin starts at 6:30 PM and the rodeo begins at 7:30 PM.

item.title: Emo Orchestra with The Spill Canvas: An Evening of Emo (SAT 11/7)
item.description: Sat 11/7 · 7:00 PM (doors 6:00 PM) | Vinyl Music Hall | from $41. Emo Nite presents Emo Orchestra with support from The Spill Canvas and Greywind, billed as an evening of emo at Vinyl Music Hall. Doors open at 6 PM for a 7 PM start, and the show is all ages.

item.title: Experience the Oyster at The Hangout (SAT 11/7)
item.description: Fri 11/6 · VIP party 6:00 PM to 10:00 PM · Sat 11/7 · 11:30 AM to 5:00 PM | The Hangout | from $40. Experience the Oyster brings more than 25 chefs from across the Southeast to The Hangout for a beachfront oyster festival, with raw, fried, chargrilled and baked oysters from farms around the region. General admission includes 10 tasting tickets on Saturday, and live music and SEC football on the big screens round out the day. A VIP kickoff party at Zeke's Restaurant runs Friday night.

item.title: Finding Neverland at Joe Jefferson Playhouse (SAT 11/7)
item.description: Fridays and Saturdays 7:30 PM · Sundays 2:30 PM | Joe Jefferson Playhouse | from $26.75. Joe Jefferson Players stage Finding Neverland, the musical about playwright J.M. Barrie and how he came to write Peter Pan. Shows run three weekends, Friday and Saturday evenings and Sunday afternoons. Tickets are $26.75.

item.title: Foo Foo Festival (SAT 11/7)
item.description: Thu 10/29 to Mon 11/9 | Downtown Pensacola | No published price. Foo Foo Festival runs across downtown Pensacola from October 29 through November 9, one of the destination's own signature annual events. Visit Pensacola's page for it doesn't spell out a program, since it covers many venues under one banner.

item.title: Frank Brown International Songwriters' Festival (SAT 11/7)
item.description: Thu 11/5 to Sun 11/15 · times vary by stage | Flora-Bama Lounge and more than two dozen stages along the Gulf Coast | No published price. More than 200 songwriters play over 600 performances on more than two dozen stages along the Florida and Alabama Gulf Coast during this 11-day festival, which grew out of the Flora-Bama on Perdido Key. Songwriters tell the stories behind their songs, from Grammy winners to rising talent. Many shows are free, and some are ticketed or charge a cover.

item.title: Game Days at Marina Bar & Grill (SAT 11/7)
item.description: Saturdays (college football) and Sundays (NFL), plus select Monday and Thursday nights | Marina Bar & Grill, Sandestin Golf and Beach Resort | No published price. Marina Bar & Grill at Baytowne Marina runs its own Game Days program, showing NCAA football on Saturdays and NFL games on Sundays plus select Monday and Thursday nights. It sits right on the marina at Sandestin.

item.title: Great Gulfcoast Arts Festival (SAT 11/7)
item.description: Fri 11/6 to Sun 11/8 · 9 AM to 5 PM Fri and Sat, 9 AM to 4 PM Sun | Seville Square | Free. The Great Gulfcoast Arts Festival fills Seville Square with more than 200 juried painters, potters, sculptors, jewellers and other artists over three days. Live music plays from the main stage, heritage artists demonstrate traditional crafts, and the Children's Arts Festival has free hands-on projects. Admission is free. Pets are not allowed, and downtown parking is tight, so plan to walk in from a distance.

item.title: Greater Gulf State Fair (SAT 11/7)
item.description: Oct 30 to Nov 8 · Weekdays 4 PM · Weekends 12 PM | Greater Gulf State Fairgrounds | No published price. The Greater Gulf State Fair fills the Mobile fairgrounds for ten days with a midway of rides, a rodeo, a community stage and a pickin porch. It is the largest fair in the Mobile area and a good outing for a family that wants a full evening of rides and fair food. Children 4 and under do not need an admission ticket, though they do need a wristband to ride. General admission and ride prices are not printed on the fair's pages, so check the ticket store before driving over.

item.title: Guys and Dolls at Stage Crafters (SAT 11/7)
item.description: Fri 11/6 to Sun 11/15 · Fri and Sat 7:30 PM, Sun 2:00 PM | Stage Crafters Theatre | from $32. Stage Crafters stages the Damon Runyon musical comedy Guys and Dolls over two weekends in November. Gambler Nathan Detroit hunts for cash to run the biggest craps game in New York while his fiancee Adelaide waits out a fourteen-year engagement. The company bills itself as Florida's oldest all-volunteer community theatre, now in its 54th year.

item.title: Jazz Art Writers South Festival Youth Exhibit 2026 (SAT 11/7)
item.description: Nov 1 to Dec 15 · all day during branch hours, closed Sundays | Monte L. Moorer/Spring Hill Branch Library | No published price. More than fifty paintings by artists ages 8 to 18 who attend local public schools interpret jazz music at the Monte L. Moorer/Spring Hill Branch Library. The JAWS Festival put the exhibit together with the Mobile Arts Council and the Amp Up Arts Program, and it hangs from November 1 through December 15 during branch hours, which are Monday to Saturday.

item.title: Lightspill (mirrored-sphere art installation) (SAT 11/7)
item.description: Thursday 10/29 to Monday 11/9 · times not posted | Artel Gallery | Free. Lightspill is a large temporary public art installation by Friends of Downtown on the front of the historic Artel Gallery building in downtown Pensacola. Hundreds of mirrored spheres appear to pour over the facade, and the look changes through the day with light and weather. It's free and open to the public, from October 29 to November 9, as part of Foo Foo Festival.

item.title: Magnolia Run 5K and 1 mile fun run (SAT 11/7)
item.description: Saturday 11/7 · 5K 8:00 AM, 1 mile 9:00 AM | Jesse's Restaurant (start and finish) | from $25. The Magnolia Run passes oak canopies, azaleas and historic homes in Magnolia Springs, starting and finishing at Jesse's Restaurant. RunSignup says it is stroller and dog friendly, and every participant gets a medal. Part of each registration goes to Impact Gulf Coast.

item.title: Make Your Own Glass (hot glass, by appointment) (SAT 11/7)
item.description: By appointment: Wednesdays 5 PM-9 PM, Saturdays 8 AM-11 AM | First City Art Center | from $85. Make Your Own Glass is a hands-on hot glass session at First City Art Center in Pensacola, where each participant makes a piece with a glassblower. It's for ages 8 and up including adults, by appointment on Wednesdays from 5-9 PM and Saturdays from 8-11 AM. The finished piece cools in an annealing oven and is picked up the following week. Standard pieces cost $85, and premium pieces such as a pumpkin, ornament, cup or bowl cost $110-$140.

item.title: Mobile in the Gilded Age exhibition at the History Museum of Mobile (SAT 11/7)
item.description: Monday to Saturday 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM · Sunday 1:00 PM to 5:00 PM · through 6/6/2027 | History Museum of Mobile | from $8. The History Museum of Mobile opened Mobile in the Gilded Age on October 9, 2026, and the exhibition stays up through June 6, 2027. Gowns, inventions and everyday objects show how railroads, new technology and department stores changed life in Mobile in the late 1800s and early 1900s. The exhibition also covers the unequal opportunities and segregation of the period.

item.title: Mobile Music Legends exhibit at Moorer Branch Library (SAT 11/7)
item.description: Library hours · 11/1 to 12/15 · closed Sundays | Monte L. Moorer/Spring Hill Branch Library | No published price. The Monte L. Moorer/Spring Hill Branch Library hosts the first annual Mobile Music Legends exhibit. The display celebrates artists and ensembles who carried the soul, jazz and spirit of the Gulf Coast to the world. The exhibit stays up from November 1 to December 15.

item.title: Mobile Symphony: Beethoven and Blue Jeans (SAT 11/7)
item.description: Sat 11/7 · 7:30 PM · Sun 11/8 · 2:30 PM | Saenger Theatre | No published price. Conductor Scott Speck leads the Mobile Symphony in two Beethoven favorites, Symphony No. 5 and the Emperor Piano Concerto with pianist Stewart Goodyear. The program opens with Valerie Coleman's Seven O'Clock Shout, and the concert runs about an hour and a half with intermission. The title is the dress code, so come relaxed.

item.title: Night Moves Music Fest (SAT 11/7)
item.description: Thursday 10/29 to Sunday 11/8 · times vary by show | The Handlebar, Lagunas, Odd Colony, Betty's and more | No published price. Night Moves is a multi-venue music festival across Pensacola for eleven days, covering indie and alternative, punk, EDM and singer-songwriter shows. Venues named include The Handlebar, Lagunas, Odd Colony and Betty's. Individual shows at The Handlebar are listed as all ages at $20 to $25, with doors at 6 PM and music at 7 PM.

item.title: North Florida Gun and Knife Show (SAT 11/7)
item.description: Saturday 11/7 · 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM · Sunday 11/8 · 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM | Pensacola Interstate Fairgrounds, Building 1 | from $12. Florida Gun Shows runs its Pensacola gun and knife show in Building 1 at the Interstate Fairgrounds over a weekend. Admission is $12 and tickets can be bought online. The pages publish no rules for children or parking.

item.title: Painting with a Twist Pensacola: paint-and-sip, family paint days and date nights (weekly programme) (SAT 11/7)
item.description: Classes most days: family days Saturday 10:30 AM, brunch Sunday 11 AM, evenings Wednesday to Saturday | Painting with a Twist Pensacola | $35 per family. Painting with a Twist Pensacola is an artist-led paint-and-sip studio at 4771 Bayou Blvd Suite C11 with several classes every week. October has family paint days (ages 6 and up with a parent, no alcohol), adult Paint & Sip and Date Night classes (ages 16 and up on date nights), Halloween-themed canvases and Paint Your Pet. Classes cost $35-$60 depending on the class, and alcohol is sold on site with no BYOB.

item.title: Pensacola Symphony: Mozart and Bizet dress rehearsal (SAT 11/7)
item.description: Saturday 11/7 · doors 1:00 PM, rehearsal 1:30 PM, about 150 minutes | Saenger Theatre | from $10. Pensacola Symphony opens its working dress rehearsal of the Mozart and Bizet program to the public on the afternoon of the evening concert. Many pieces are played in full and some sections are stopped and retouched, so it is a look at how a concert is finished. The program is Stravinsky's Pulcinella Suite, Mozart's Piano Concerto No. 24 with Carter Johnson and Bizet's Symphony in C, conducted by Peter Rubardt.

item.title: Pilates and Pumpkins at Holland Farms (SAT 11/7)
item.description: Friday 11/6 · 6:30 AM to 7:30 AM · Sunday 11/15 · 4:15 PM to 5:15 PM | Holland Farms | from $20. Holland Farms holds two more Pilates and Pumpkins classes on the farm in November. The Friday November 6 session runs from 6:30 AM to 7:30 AM, and the Sunday November 15 session runs from 4:15 PM to 5:15 PM. The class is $20 a person, bought online by date. All sales are final.

item.title: Pokémon League at GameMasters Guild (SAT 11/7)
item.description: Thursdays 3 PM-8 PM and Saturdays 12 PM-2 PM | GameMasters Guild | Free. Pokémon League at GameMasters Guild is free casual play for the Pokémon TCG, the Pokémon Champions video game and Pokémon GO. It runs Thursdays from 3 to 8 PM and Saturdays from 12 to 2 PM in Crestview. All ages are welcome, and the shop calls it a family-friendly space. Players get promo cards or special items while supplies last, and a free Pokémon account is needed to qualify (children under 13 register under a parent's account).

item.title: Public Ice Skating at the Pensacola Bay Center, November sessions (SAT 11/7)
item.description: Nov 1 to Nov 25 · one hour sessions, see dates | Pensacola Bay Center | from $15. The Pensacola Bay Center opens its ice for one-hour public skate sessions. The November sessions run Sunday 11/1 at 6:30 PM, Saturday 11/7 and Sunday 11/8 at 1:30, 3:00 and 4:30 PM, Friday 11/13 and Saturday 11/14 at 9:30 PM, Sunday 11/15 at 1:30, 3:00 and 4:30 PM, and Wednesday 11/25 at 9:30 PM. The Bay Center states that all sessions are subject to change.

item.title: Qigong classes at Historic Blakeley (SAT 11/7)
item.description: Saturday 11/7 · 9:00 AM to 10:00 AM · Saturday 11/21 · 9:00 AM to 10:00 AM | Historic Blakeley State Park | from $10. Historic Blakeley State Park offers guided Qigong, a slow, low-impact practice that combines movement, deep breathing and visualization and is described as an ancestor of Tai Chi. Classes run from 9:00 AM to 10:00 AM on Saturday 11/7 and Saturday 11/21, with an optional group hike afterward. They take place rain or shine unless there is lightning or severe weather.

item.title: Science on the Street (sound and music science) (SAT 11/7)
item.description: Thursday 10/29 to Sunday 11/8 · Sound Booth Fri 10/30 5:00 PM to 7:00 PM, Sun 11/1 2:00 PM to 4:00 PM, Sat 11/7 10:00 AM to 12:00 PM and 2:00 PM to 4:00 PM | Palafox Street between Garden and Main | Free. Science on the Street is a self-guided, hands-on look at the science of sound on Palafox Street between Garden and Main in Pensacola, from October 29 to November 8. It has oversized instruments, tuning forks, sound-wave displays and acoustics demonstrations. The Pensacola MESS Hall runs it as part of Foo Foo Festival, and it's free.

item.title: Show Me Reptiles reptile show (SAT 11/7)
item.description: Saturday 11/7 and Sunday 11/8 · hours not published | Pensacola Interstate Fairgrounds, Building 6 | No published price. A Show Me Reptiles reptile show takes over Building 6 at the Pensacola Interstate Fairgrounds for a weekend. The fairgrounds page gives no hours, ticket price or vendor list. Call the fair office at (850) 944-4500 before going.

item.title: Side Show (musical, PenArts) (SAT 11/7)
item.description: Friday 10/30 7:30 PM · Sunday 11/1 2:30 PM · Tuesday 11/3 to Saturday 11/7 7:30 PM · Sunday 11/8 2:30 PM · 11/6 and 11/8 sold out | The Gordon Community Art Center | from $22. Side Show is a musical staged by PenArts at The Gordon Community Art Center in Pensacola, about conjoined twins who became vaudeville stars. It plays Friday, October 30 through Sunday, November 8, with 7:30 PM evening shows and 2:30 PM Sunday matinees. The Friday, November 6 evening show and the Sunday, November 8 matinee are sold out. It suits elementary-school ages and up. The Spectacle, a free preshow with music, popcorn and games, starts an hour before each show outside the venue. General admission is $22 on the PenArts ticket page.

item.title: Story Time and Craft at Foley Community Library (SAT 11/7)
item.description: Tuesdays 10:00 AM and 5:30 PM · Saturdays 10:00 AM | Foley Community Library | No published price. The Foley Community Library holds a story time with a craft every Tuesday and Saturday from August through May. Tuesday sessions run at 10:00 AM and 5:30 PM, and the Saturday session runs at 10:00 AM. No age limit or price is posted.

item.title: Tacos & Tequila Festival (SAT 11/7)
item.description: Sat 11/7 · 10 AM-6 PM · Sun 11/8 · 10 AM-5 PM | Heritage Park | from $5. Beach Life Events' Foley festival combines taco vendors and alcoholic drink sales with artists, crafters, live music and family activities including inflatables and a petting zoo. Children age 12 and under are admitted free, but alcohol is sold on site and no outside food or drink is allowed.
